fragment.response_text: {"paragraphs":[{"paragraph_id":"MA-S3:P2__f1","paragraph_markdown":"When positional encoding is enabled, the model enriches passage representations by computing the element-wise sum of passage embeddings, document ID embeddings, and passage ID embeddings. The document ID embedding is obtained by indexing into a learned table with a composite index formed from the document identifier modulo the retrieval top-k parameter plus the document identifier divided by that same top-k value, thereby decomposing each document identifier into a within-batch offset and a batch-level quotient. Before the attention computation, the query vector is reshaped to introduce a sequence dimension, yielding a tensor of shape [batch_size, 1, hidden_size]. After the dedicated attention layer produces per-passage similarity scores, the similarities are sorted in descending order along the passage dimension via torch.sort, yielding a pair of relevance scores and their corresponding passage indices."}],"section_id":"MA-S3"}
